What divides an agent from a mask is Ribbonworker heraldic banner warrant embroidered onto the thread yard, and the division is each heraldic banner is a measured thread yield plus an embroiderer signature. A quill can be bought before noon, a ledge can be borrowed within the hour, but a beacon is counted in seasons, and seasons will not be hurried. Farming stops paying when the bill tops the prize, and here the bill is 65840 POA against one epoch's reward.
